description: Land Acquisition - Maharagama, Wellawaya D/S DIvision, Monaragala District - Correction Notices Extraordinary Gaz. No. 2161/27, dated 06.02.2020
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition for the Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Project, detailing specific land lots, their boundaries, and extents. It falls under the Land Gazettes category as it deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
